source: I want a soccer game with bots to play if there's no one to play with I want spawn to be a field with a world cup trophy in the middle of spawn then I want a shop so you can buy celebrations and dance then I want a goalkeeper to guard the goal. then I want rounds of 32,16 quarter final semi finals and then finals. If there is a tie it goes to penalty shootout up to 5 tries to win. Then I was a crowd around the stadium and hear cheering for the teams I want to have a flag pick between France Spain Portugal Argentina New Zealand America Canada Morocco Cape Verde Brazil England Uruguay Croatia Germany Norway. You can choose between any team and swap at any time not in the middle of gameplay though. then I want a shop so people can buy a flag to play 2,500 for Argentina 2,500 for other countries. You earn 250 in game coins for every win. Everytime you goal 10 coins. I want a cheer for the winner of the final. And a flag of Spain for them winning the 2026 world cup.

answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a real modern World Cup-style stadium, with a large crowd, national flags, and the Spain 2026 winner presentation.

answers.ask: Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch?
answers.answer: Use a compact arcade-sized pitch with full stands so rounds are quick and easy to play.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D soccer stadium map styled as a modern World Cup venue, centered on a compact arcade-sized regulation-style pitch with two goals and a goalkeeper positioned at each goal. Full spectator stands tightly surround the field, packed with a large crowd and decorated with national flags representing the selectable teams. At the spawn area, place a World Cup-style trophy as the central landmark, with a nearby shop building or kiosk. Include a finals presentation area featuring Spanish flags and a Spain 2026 winner display.

## Genre
The dominant and only genre is Sports: the compact soccer match, goals, teams, and tournament presentation all support court-and-field competition.

## Shape and preset
Use one `space-bounded` shape for the compact pitch and tightly enclosing stadium. The preset is Full Stadium, expanded with the match boundaries, scoring goals, start positions, crowd, trophy spawn, shop kiosk, and finals presentation explicitly requested.

## Config requirements
Draw `spectator-bleachers` as full tiered stands wrapping all four sides. Draw `barrier-perimeter` as the stadium’s enclosing outer wall. Draw `spectator-zone` as team-side technical areas beside the pitch. Draw `trigger-bounds` as crisp pitch lines, `startpoint-play` as center and team reset markings, and `trigger-scoring` as two visible goals. Draw `npc-population` as a large crowd and two goalkeepers, one at each goal. Also draw one World Cup-style trophy, one nearby shop kiosk, national flag dressing, and a separate Spain 2026 finals podium.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-bounds` perimeter precisely on the pitch lines. Place `startpoint-play` markers at the center spot and balanced team reset positions. Place two `trigger-scoring` goal volumes inside the goal mouths. Site two functional `npc-population` goalkeeper positions on their respective goal lines and crowd occupancy across every stand section.

## Layout components
Center one compact arcade-sized rectangular pitch with two opposite goals and clear markings. Surround it closely with four connected banks of full stands and an outer stadium wall. Put the trophy-led spawn concourse near one side of the pitch, with the shop kiosk beside it. Place the finals presentation zone where it remains visible from the field and stands, dressed with Spanish flags and a Spain 2026 winner display. Keep circulation clear between spawn, pitch entry, kiosk, and podium.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the authoritative plan comes first because pitch symmetry, goal alignment, and clear circulation must remain playable; derive the dressed stadium view from it.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale is medium: a compact field inside full stands. The theme is a realistic modern World Cup venue with celebratory national color. Use `tiered` because stepped bleachers rise without overhang; no other modifier is forced.
